parameters.prompt:
=You are an expert sales proposal generator. 

Generate a professional, compelling sales proposal based on the following information:

Lead Name: {{ $json.lead_name }}
Lead Email: {{ $json.lead_email }}
Proposal Template: {{ $json.proposal_template }}
Key Points to Include: {{ $json.key_points }}

Your task:
1. Create a professional proposal that addresses the lead's needs
2. Include pricing, timeline, and deliverables
3. Make it compelling and personalized to the lead
4. Use professional business language
5. Structure with: Executive Summary, Problem Statement, Proposed Solution, Pricing, Timeline, Next Steps

Response MUST be VALID JSON in this exact format:
{
  "title": "Proposal for [Lead Name]",
  "executive_summary": "2-3 sentence summary",
  "problem_statement": "What problem does this solve",
  "proposed_solution": "Detailed solution description",
  "pricing": {
    "base_package": "$X,XXX",
    "premium_package": "$X,XXX",
    "currency": "USD"
  },
  "timeline": "Implementation timeline here",
  "deliverables": ["Item 1", "Item 2", "Item 3"],
  "next_steps": "What happens after acceptance",
  "valid_until": "YYYY-MM-DD (30 days from now)"
}

Respond ONLY with valid JSON, no markdown, no code fences.

=Review this sales proposal for quality, completeness, and compliance issues:

Proposal:
{{ JSON.stringify($json.proposal_json, null, 2) }}

Check for:
1. Pricing consistency and reasonableness
2. Spelling and grammar errors
3. Brand guideline compliance
4. Required sections present (pricing, timeline, deliverables)
5. Professional language and tone
6. Any missing information

Respond with VALID JSON only (no markdown):
{
  "is_valid": true/false,
  "issues": ["issue 1", "issue 2"],
  "approved": true/false,
  "confidence_score": 0.0-1.0
}

parameters.responseData:
={
  "status": "success",
  "request_id": "{{ $('Validate Input').item.json.request_id }}",
  "message": "Proposal generated and submitted for review",
  "approved": {{ $('Parse Validation Results').item.json.reviewer_approved }},
  "generated_at": "{{ $('Parse & Validate Proposal').item.json.generated_at }}"
}

parameters.subject: ✅ Proposal Generated for {{ $('Validate Input').item.json.lead_name }}
parameters.message:
=

Proposal Generated Successfully

Lead: {{ $('Validate Input').item.json.lead_name }} ({{ $('Validate Input').item.json.lead_email }})

Template: {{ $('Validate Input').item.json.proposal_template }}

Status: {{ $('Parse Validation Results').item.json.reviewer_approved ? '✅ Approved by Guardrails' : '⚠️ Needs Review' }}

Confidence Score: {{ $('Parse Validation Results').item.json.confidence_score }}%

{{ $('Parse Validation Results').item.json.guardrail_errors.length > 0 ? '

Issues Found:

    ' + $('Parse Validation Results').item.json.guardrail_errors.map(e => '
  • ' + e + '
    • ').join('') + '

' : '' }}

View in Smady

parameters.query:
INSERT INTO proposal_review_log (meeting_id, lead_email, proposal_json, guardrail_errors, reviewer_approved, reviewer_issues, final_status, context_json)
VALUES (
  '{{ $('Validate Input').item.json.request_id }}',
  '{{ $('Validate Input').item.json.lead_email }}',
  '{{ JSON.stringify($('Parse & Validate Proposal').item.json.proposal_json).replace(/'/g, "''") }}'::jsonb,
  ARRAY[{{ $('Parse Validation Results').item.json.guardrail_errors.map(e => "'" + e.replace(/'/g, "''") + "'").join(',') }}]::text[],
  {{ $('Parse Validation Results').item.json.reviewer_approved }},
  ARRAY[{{ $('Parse Validation Results').item.json.guardrail_errors.map(e => "'" + e.replace(/'/g, "''") + "'").join(',') }}]::text[],
  '{{ $('Parse Validation Results').item.json.reviewer_approved ? 'approved' : 'needs_review' }}',
  '{{ JSON.stringify($('Validate Input').item.json).replace(/'/g, "''") }}'::jsonb
);
